title: Add Pathfinder coverage and audit tests
description:
Add tests and audit reports that verify Pathfinder generated-pack completeness, expected categories, stable keys, schema validity, and suspicious/missing fields.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
acceptance_criteria:
- Coverage tests assert expected category counts or reviewed coverage baselines.
- Schema validation covers all generated records.
- Audit report identifies missing optional/required fields.
- Tests fail on nondeterministic output or malformed records.
